description: Write the third design review's resolutions R1-R7 into the spec, then move the app from / to /app (app/app/page.tsx, app.css imported by the app and /about pages, not the layout), move today's /welcome page to / as an interim landing page, delete app/welcome, add the /welcome 308 redirect, robots.ts, manifest start_url /app, precache /, /app, /about, sw.ts fallback /app; repoint every in-app link, e2e helper, perf script, CI probe and agent setting; update the route docs and steering. First feature: everything later builds on it.
steps: Plan step 1: edit .kiro/specs/marketing-site/design.md and tasks.md with R1-R7 exactly as written in plan.md 'Review resolutions'; add a '## Responses to the third design review' table (7 rows). tm-lint both files.

Plan step 2: create packages/web/app/app/page.tsx (`import { CommunicationScreen } from '@/components/CommunicationScreen'; import '@/styles/app.css';` default export Page returning <CommunicationScreen />); remove `import '../styles/app.css'` from app/layout.tsx; add `import '@/styles/app.css'` to app/about/page.tsx; copy app/welcome/page.tsx to app/page.tsx (rename export HomePage, hero wrapper id="top", brand href="#top", every app link href="/app", comment: app is at /app per ADR-006); delete packages/web/app/welcome/ (page.tsx only).

Plan step 3: app/about/page.tsx <Brand href="/app" />, 'Back to the keypad' href="/app", 'See the demo, the measured results and the source code' href="/"; components/Footer.tsx line 10 Back to the keypad href="/app", line 11 How Ninth Life works href="/", comment line 4 'The / link works offline: next.config.mjs precaches it'; components/MenuSheet.tsx line 113 href="/"; test/footer.test.tsx expectations ['How Ninth Life works', '/'] and ['Back to the keypad', '/app'], it() names start with 'MS-1.5'.

Plan step 4: next.config.mjs additionalPrecacheEntries [{ url: '/', revision: rev }, { url: '/app', revision: rev }, { url: '/about', revision: rev }, ...publicEntries()] and `async redirects() { return [{ source: '/welcome', destination: '/', permanent: true }]; }` in nextConfig; public/manifest.webmanifest start_url '/app'; app/sw.ts fallback url '/app' plus a header-comment line; new app/robots.ts (force-static, `import type { MetadataRoute } from 'next'`, returns { rules: { userAgent: '*', allow: '/' } }).

Plan step 5: new packages/web/test/routes.test.ts with the routes.test.ts cases of design.md Test plan except MS-10.6 (added in FEAT-002): MS-1.1, MS-1.2 (Page().type === CommunicationScreen), MS-1.3, MS-1.4, MS-1.5, MS-1.7, MS-2.1, MS-2.2, MS-2.3, MS-3.5, MS-11.3. Source files are read as text with readFileSync(resolve(__dirname, '../...')).

Plan step 6: test/e2e/lib.mjs openApp(page, path = '/app') and newContext option serviceWorkers = 'block' passed through; responsive.mjs line 70 goto(BASE_URL + '/app'); axe.mjs TARGETS [{ name: 'landing /', path: '/' }, { name: 'app /app', path: '/app', app: true }, { name: 'about /about', path: '/about' }, { name: 'settings sheet on /app', path: '/app', app: true, settings: true }]; scripts/perf-check.mjs lines 262, 305, 380 goto(BASE_URL + '/app'); .github/workflows/ci.yml line 90 probe "$BASE_URL/app".

Plan step 7: .kiro/agents/a11y-auditor.json default route http://localhost:3000/app in prompt and welcomeMessage plus the website-motion method line; .kiro/workflows/ship-feature.workflow.json audit URL http://localhost:3000/app (curl probes may stay on /). Run node scripts/validate-kiro-config.mjs and node scripts/check-kiro-not-ignored.mjs.

Plan step 8: route docs with the exact text of design.md 'Changes to other specs, steering and docs': .kiro/specs/web-ui/requirements.md (intro, 5.1, Req 11 scope + 11.3, 14.3, 23.4, 25.6), web-ui design.md (diagram, offline), web-ui tasks.md row 56; .kiro/steering/structure.md; .kiro/steering/product.md Devices sentence; docs/architecture/web.md route map; docs/README.md ADR-006 line after ADR-005; docs/decisions/ADR-003 Consequences scope line; docs/plan/01-implementation-plan.md F12 note + F21; docs/testing/README.md axe row and 'The website' section; docs/testing/performance.md precache notes. tm-lint them.

Plan step 9: dev-server check (curl :3000/app, warning if not 200); from packages/web BASE_URL=http://localhost:3000 node test/e2e/{keyboard,switch,spell,responsive,axe}.mjs and ENGINE=webkit responsive.mjs; add a KIRO_LOG row with node scripts/kiro-log.mjs add; tick tasks 3-9 and 4.1 in .kiro/specs/marketing-site/tasks.md.
acceptance_criteria: `pnpm -F @ninth/web test --run` passes, including the new routes.test.ts and the updated footer.test.tsx
packages/web/app/welcome/ no longer exists; GET http://localhost:3000/welcome answers 308 to / (after a dev restart if needed); /app shows the keypad
keyboard.mjs, switch.mjs, spell.mjs, responsive.mjs (Chromium and WebKit) and axe.mjs pass against http://localhost:3000
node scripts/validate-kiro-config.mjs and node scripts/check-kiro-not-ignored.mjs pass; tm-lint is clean on every changed file
verification: cd packages/web && BASE_URL=http://localhost:3000 node test/e2e/keyboard.mjs (and switch, spell, responsive, axe; ENGINE=webkit responsive)
findings: Verification (all from this checkout, dev server on :3000): pnpm -r typecheck pass; pnpm -F @ninth/web test --run pass (24 files, 223 tests, incl. new routes.test.ts 11 tests and footer.test.tsx 3); tm-lint clean on 32 changed files; validate-kiro-config ok (10 hooks); check-kiro-not-ignored ok (notes 4 untracked files under .kiro/); curl /app 200, /welcome '308 http://localhost:3000/' (no dev restart needed, Next dev reloaded next.config.mjs), / 200, /robots.txt 200; e2e from packages/web with BASE_URL=http://localhost:3000: keyboard, switch, spell, responsive (Chromium), axe (targets landing /, app /app, about /about, settings sheet on /app; Night+Day, 1280+390) and ENGINE=webkit responsive all 'all checks passed'. Notes for later steps: (1) The shell tool often reports a timeout even when the command finished; redirect output to /tmp/*.log and read the file, and run long e2e via nohup sh -c '...' & with logs. (2) Interim app/page.tsx is today's /welcome copy (export HomePage, hero div id="top", brand href="#top", app links /app); it still uses results.modelNotRun and the 'Built with Kiro' lines, which FEAT-002 step 10/12 replace. (3) routes.test.ts helper hrefOf() matches text in TSX source; MS-10.6 (safe areas in site.css) is not in it yet, add in step 14; tasks.md task 7 is ticked with that note. (4) responsive.mjs had only one explicit goto (rotate notice) plus openApp(page); both now reach /app. (5) app/layout.tsx keeps a comment saying app.css is imported by the app pages; site.css has no safe-area padding yet (step 13). (6) web-ui tasks.md got a new section 'Route move (ADR-006)' with row 56 ticked; docs/plan F21 row says 'In progress'; docs/testing/performance.md precache note says byte figures are re-measured after the next production build (FEAT-005). (7) structure.md now says ADR-000 to ADR-006 and F1-F21. (8) KIRO_LOG row added via kiro-log.mjs (dated 2026-11-10). Nothing committed.
